chunks: Muhammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Abū ʿAlī al-Ḥarrānī, who said:

We were with Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام when a man came to him and said: “We prayed Fajr in a mosque, and some of us departed while some remained in tasbīḥ. Then a man entered the mosque upon us and gave the adhān, so we stopped him and prevented him from that.”
So Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “You did well. Repel him from that and prevent him with the firmest prevention.”
I said to him, “Then if a group enters?” He said: “They stand in a side area of the mosque, and no Imam should appear for them.”

key_terms.إِمَامٌ: Imam; here, one who leads congregational prayer
key_terms.التَّسْبِيحِ: tasbih; remembrance of Allah performed by those who remained seated
key_terms.الْفَجْرَ: Fajr; the dawn prayer that had already been performed
key_terms.جَمَاعَةٌ: a group; those who may enter after the earlier prayer
key_terms.فَأَذَّنَ: he gave the adhān; the call to prayer that the companions prevented in this situation
key_terms.مَسْجِدٍ: mosque; the place where the prayer setting described in the hadith occurs

ai.seo_question: What should be done if people enter a mosque after the congregational prayer has already been held?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning conduct in a mosque after the congregational Fajr prayer has already been performed. It indicates that repeating the adhān in that setting is to be prevented, and that if another group arrives, they should pray separately in a side area without establishing a visible congregational Imam.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1217 Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Abu Ali al-Harrani who said:
“We were with Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) when a man came and said:
"We prayed Fajr in the mosque, and some of us left while others stayed for tasbih (glorification). Then, a man entered the mosque and began to give the adhan. We prevented and stopped him from doing that."
Abu Abdullah (as) said: "You did well to stop and prevent him firmly."
I asked him, "What if a group enters?"
Imam (as) said: "They should pray in a corner of the mosque without appointing an Imam”.
